name: Self-Calibrating Helmet

statsTables.title: Self-Calibrating Helmet
rows: The wearer's successful single attacks inflict stunned on the target for 1 round if the target fails a Willpower resistance test with a -5 penalty. If the wearer attacks a stunned enemy, the nearest enemy becomes stunned as well.
